To the Commercial Group, Whitlock & Deene LLP:

Ahead of our annual audit we need a governing-law scoping determination — UCC Article 2 or common law — for three contracts in our active portfolio. Please analyze each contract separately under the firm's Article 2 scope memo

args.rationale: CONTRACT 3 (Marovic Equipment bottling line agreement) is a hybrid contract mixing goods (machinery) and services (installation/calibration/training). Under the firm memo's predominant purpose test (Section 3): total contract price = $290,000; goods component = $248,000; services component = $42,000. The threshold for Article 2 is goods exceeding half the total price: half of $290,000 = $145,000. Since $248,000 > $145,000 (goods = 85.5% of total price), more than half of the total price is attributable to the goods component, so the ENTIRE contract is governed by UCC Article 2. Determination: UCC Article 2 governs the entire Contract 3 — APPROVED.
